items.headline: US Federal Reserve Holds Benchmark Interest Rate Steady at 3.5 to 3.75 Percent
items.summary: On July 29, 2026, the US Federal Reserve decided to maintain its benchmark interest rate in a target range of 3.5 to 3.75 percent. Three policymakers dissented from the decision, preferring a quarter-point rate increase due to elevated inflation and energy supply shocks.

items.headline: Detroit Tigers Ace Tarik Skubal Hits 1,000th Strikeout Amid Major Trade Rumors
items.summary: On July 29, Detroit Tigers pitcher Tarik Skubal recorded his 1,000th career strikeout in just 857 innings, becoming the fastest player in franchise history to reach the milestone. The historic performance comes at a critical moment as the two-time Cy Young winner is heavily rumored to be traded before Major League Baseball's upcoming deadline.

items.headline: Apple TV Releases 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 Trailer
items.summary: Apple TV unveiled the official trailer for season four of 'Ted Lasso,' setting the popular comedy's premiere for August 5, 2026. The new season follows Jason Sudeikis' titular character as he returns to England to take on the fresh challenge of coaching a second-division women's soccer team.
